snippet.title: Silver Palace丨Dichotomy Beta Test Gameplay Showcase - The Raven and the Rose
snippet.description:
The curtain rises on a pageant of human nature laid bare.
Some mask their sins upon the dance floor, while others reconstruct truth from ruin and bone.

An unseen author has inscribed fate's first stroke. When the final act dissolves into silence, the crowd disperses, twilight descends, and the ravens fly homeward once more. Tell me, Detective, what answer do you hope to find?
